event: The party walks Floor 12's first passage: narrow, white calcite, low ceiling, slick floor.
Solenne widens her stance on the polished floor; Tomás moves with a slight forward lean.
Tomás stops at a glowing calcite formation and names it Crystal Resonance.
Solenne's Arcane Analysis: a Resonance Node needing RES 15+ within 2m; 7 on the floor.
The Analysis notes no party has ever activated all seven Nodes.
Dayo steps within a meter; the Node hums awake and a cache seam appears in the floor.
The System confirms Node 1 of 7 activated, cache 12m northeast.
Dayo says 'One' and moves on.
Tomás's entry Terrain Read maps three routes: northeast, southeast and middle.
Solenne weighs the fast northeast route, the puzzle-heavy southeast, and the middle one.
Nadia jokes that seventeen encounters sounds like a relaxing afternoon.
Tomás picks the middle route; nobody argues and the party moves in.
Twenty meters in, two patrolling Lattice Guardians start converging on the party.
Arcane Analysis: Level 12-13, ~550 HP, Crystal Sweep, and Shatter damage back on crits.
Solenne warns via the Conductor that physical crits take return damage.
Dayo answers 'Controlled hits' and limits her strike weight.
Tomás puts steady non-crit fire into the first Guardian's left shoulder joint.
Nadia's Stumble throws the second Guardian into the wall, breaking its timing.
Vesper Quick Crafts a Freeze compound; Solenne's Arcane Bolt slows the second Guardian.
The Guardians fall after ninety seconds.
Vesper collects the Calcite Fragments and notes their crystal-resonance inscriptions.
Halfway along the passage, Solenne is struck by the Labyrinth's cold, prismatic beauty.
She writes: Floor 12. Calcite Labyrinth. White. The crystal light goes sideways.
Tomás, RES 13, pauses curiously by a second Node but does not step close.
Solenne watches him not touch the Node and feels something she cannot categorize.
Thirty meters on, Miriam activates the second Node in a side alcove.
Miriam lingers, reads her clinical notebook, looks at the Node, and writes something.
Miriam closes the notebook and joins the others at the cache.
The party rests in a sheltered natural widening between two calcite formations.
Vesper sets up the Field Forge in the smaller half of the alcove.
Nadia sits against the wall reading her Class Aptitude Assessment in her Status Window.
Nadia notices Solenne watching, closes the Window and says she is checking a thing.
Nadia says the phrase 'paying very close attention' is harder to dismiss than 'careless.'
Nadia asks to walk ahead alone for ten minutes, staying in Terrain Read range.
Solenne agrees to ten minutes.
Nadia walks up the passage and out of sight around the calcite curve.
Miriam opens her Status Window and reads for thirty seconds, clinical-faced.
Miriam says 'Class evolution' and lists the Warden to Grove Keeper requirements.
She notes a narrative condition: keep an ally alive through a should-be-fatal wound.
Miriam says WIS 60 is 29 points away and not soon; RES 30 is closer.
Solenne says it will happen; Miriam says she cannot know that.
Solenne recalls reading her own Rare path: Level 50, stats, Six of Six with all six.
Solenne admits she looked hers up too.
Miriam notes the Harmonist path needs Six of Six, and Solenne is one RES short.
Solenne says the answer is continuing; Miriam says 'All right' and writes.
Vesper, listening while crafting, thinks over her own evolution's narrative condition.
She thinks of an unfinished project for Nadia she has set aside for four floors.
Vesper sets the last Freeze compound in the stack and prepares for the next push.
Nadia returns after nine minutes, dusted white and settled.
Nadia reports a wider chamber two hundred meters ahead with something moving in it.
Nadia tells the ceiling she has been paying close attention a long time and nobody asked.
Nobody responds; Dayo puts away her armor cloth, satisfied with the eighth dent.
Dayo asks 'Ready?' and Nadia stands, saying 'Ready.'
The party reaches a forty-meter chamber of four huge, glowing calcite columns.
Tomás uses Eagle Eye at the entrance and spots a Resonance Mimic posing as a Node.
Arcane Analysis: Level 14, ~700 HP Elite that copies skills and has targeted Solenne.
The Mimic is waiting for Solenne to be isolated; it drops a Rare Dissonance Crystal.
Solenne warns it may copy Ley Conduit at 60% and turn it on her.
Dayo says she will get between them.
The Mimic copies Tomás's Precision Shot; Dayo takes the needle on her shoulder.
It copies Nadia's Stumble, knocking Miriam two meters sideways; Miriam stays up.
Solenne cuts Ley Conduit mid-activation to deny the Mimic the template.
Vesper's Enhancement Inscription on Tomás's bow erodes the Mimic's magic defense.
By Tomás's seventh shot the Mimic's HP is critical.
Below 30% HP the Mimic copies Arcane Analysis and reads Solenne's own stats back.
Solenne sees herself: RES 19, Six of Six conditions not met, one below activation.
Nadia's Stumble slams the Mimic into a column and Dayo's gauntlet finishes it.
Vesper takes the red-violet Dissonance Crystal, notes RES-protection potential, stores it.
Solenne stares at where the Mimic hid, thinking about being one RES short.
She opens her notebook just to hold it, then closes it.
Solenne says 'Forward.'
